carga.contexto: All open cases from any earlier year, cases closed during 2026 and referrals not accepted in 2026.
carga.ayuda: Keep the original number and actual dates. Leave optional unknown data blank. The first episode starts on the acceptance date; add an episode for each reopening and keep the previous closure. Loading does not generate documents or assign new numbers. The case is marked for review. Real data may only be loaded in production after the data protection assessment, security review and backup restoration checks. The Programme has no spreadsheet. Use the records or enter the data by hand. Open cases may come from any earlier year. A digital signature provides a proposed date; its validity is not checked. If the PDF is an image, enter the data by hand.
carga.formato: Each spreadsheet contains 1 to 100 cases from one team. CSV: UTF-8 text, separated by commas or semicolons. XLSX: one visible sheet without formulas, macros, hidden rows or external links. Use the headers in the downloadable sheet. Dates must be text in YYYY-MM-DD format and lists must be JSON. The download includes all 18 provisional columns and invented active, reopened, closed and declined cases when the team has an assigned municipality. Accepted cases also require an acceptance date, catalog municipality and centre, reference role, description, each child’s sex and episodes. The complete provisional format is in the system documentation.
carga.obligatorio: This information is required to review the load.
carga.error: We could not complete the request. Try again.
carga.error_opciones: We could not load the options. Try again.
carga.sin_equipo: No team is available for loading. Ask Administration to check your assignment.
carga.validando: Checking the data. The case has not been saved yet.
carga.antivirus: Scanning the spreadsheet for viruses and checking each row. No cases have been saved yet.
carga.guardando: Checking and saving the complete load.
carga.resultado_incierto: The connection was lost and we do not yet know whether the load was saved. Retrieve the result before preparing another load.
carga.lote_valido: Reviewed {cantidad} case files. None have been saved yet.
carga.lote_invalido: Some data needs checking in the spreadsheet with {cantidad} case files. None have been saved.
carga.consecuencia: Confirming saves all case files in the load with their historical dates and statuses. They will be marked for review.
carga.elegir_fichero: Choose the CSV or XLSX spreadsheet
carga.limite: Up to 10 MB and 100 case files from one team.
carga.descargar: Download a spreadsheet with invented data
carga.numero_desconocido: If the original number is unknown, leave it blank. No new number will be assigned.
carga.sin_guardar: Reviewing does not save data. You can then confirm the complete load.
carga.numero_formato: Enter the team, sequence and year: two digits per part, separated by hyphens.
carga.fichero_invalido: Choose a CSV or XLSX file containing data, up to 10 MB.
carga.hoja_causa: The referring service withdrew the request before intervention began.
carga.hoja_descripcion: The family requests support with daily routines and school attendance.
carga.hoja_reapertura: The family returns to the municipality and requests support again.
carga.revisar_guardado: Review saved data for case file {cantidad}
carga.sin_permiso: Your session cannot access this load. Ask Administration to check your permissions.
carga.error_lectura: We could not retrieve the saved case file. Press its review button again.
carga.guardado: The case file has been saved.
carga.lote_valido_uno: The case file has been reviewed. It has not been saved yet.
carga.lote_invalido_uno: Some data needs checking in the spreadsheet for one case file. It has not been saved.
carga.enlace_revision: Open the review for case file {cantidad}
carga.menores_derivacion: Children in the referral, if their names are known
carga.actas.contexto: Upload the Acceptance Record and, if the case is closed, its Closure Record. Then review the fields below or enter them by hand. Reading replaces the form data. Review and confirm before saving.
carga.actas.limite: PDF or Word (.docx), up to 10 MB per record. Files are discarded; only the data you confirm is saved.
carga.actas.leer: Read and fill in the fields
carga.actas.elegir_equipo: Choose the team before reading the records.
carga.actas.elegir_aceptacion: Choose the Acceptance Record to read its data.
carga.actas.antivirus: We are checking the records with the antivirus and reading their data. The case has not been saved yet.
carga.actas.revisar: We have filled in the data we could read. Review every field and fill in anything missing, including the current status. Reading replaces the form data; the case has not been saved yet.
carga.actas.sin_lectura: We could not read one or more records. Enter any missing data by hand. The case has not been saved yet.
carga.actas.no_revisado: The antivirus was unavailable for one or more records. Review the data we read and fill in anything missing. Files have been discarded; the case has not been saved yet.
carga.actas.fichero_invalido: Choose a PDF or Word (.docx) file of up to 10 MB that contains data.
carga.actas.tipo_invalido: The record does not match the selected type. Check the acceptance and closure files.
carga.actas.equipo_distinto: The record number belongs to another team. Check the selected team and the file.
carga.actas.numero_distinto: The records have different case numbers. Choose both records for the same case.
carga.actas.fecha_firma: The date was read from the signature declared in the PDF. Confirm it against the record; reading does not check whether the signature is valid.
carga.actas.sustituir_consecuencia: You have already entered data. Reading the records will replace it with a new proposal and you will need to complete anything we cannot read. Cancel to keep your data.
carga.nombre_completo: Full name read from the record
carga.resumen_datos: Data you are about to confirm
carga.nombres_revisados: Check that you have reviewed the full names in the form. Return to the data if you need to correct them.
carga.separar_para_guardar: Separate first name and surnames before reviewing. They are together in the record and we cannot reliably split them.
